Equations 1–13 and Appendix 1 are implemented. The field reference is a loop at ground level in the great-circle vertical plane. Average terminal ground: 3–10 mS/m; highly resistive ground can substantially reduce the field. No arbitrary ground, HF antenna, or space-weather corrections have been added.Research implementation without independent predictive validation. An auxiliary comparison with Figure 4 did not reproduce all curves within plot-reading tolerance; calculation explicitly follows the published equations. This remains an open report item, with no hidden empirical adjustment.Geometry uses the selected QTH coordinates; a dedicated transmitter grid represents its cell center. The geomagnetic profile uses WMM2025, not the historical map. The 30 dB daytime approximation does not replace Annex 2’s separate daytime treatment. O resultado representa uma mediana anual, não uma medição nem a previsão exata de hoje. Onda de superfície (P.368) não está incluída.A potência e a largura de banda são as selecionadas acima.
